Title: Session token storage

Authentication tokens are now stored in secure storage and cleared on logout; this touches login and session handling for all users. Acceptance criteria:
- After login, the session token is read from secure storage.
- After logout, no session token remains.

Existing tests: test/login_test.dart covers login, test/session_test.dart covers logout.
